```yaml
name: Contributor Actions

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  status-check:
    name: Check Workflow Status
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'mastra-ai/mastra' }}
    outputs:
      changed_files: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}
      has_changes: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed }}
      pr_number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number || '' }}
      is_pull_request: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get Changed Files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v45
        with:
          json: true
          files: |
            **/*
            !**/*.md
            !**/*.txt
            !**/*.json
            !**/*.yml
            !**/*.yaml
            !**/.gitignore
            !**/.prettierignore
            !**/.vercelignore
            !**/node_modules/**
            !**/dist/**
            !**/build/**
            !**/coverage/**
            !**/.next/**
            !**/pnpm-lock.yaml
            !**/package-lock.json
            !**/yarn.lock
            !**/Dockerfile
            !**/Dockerfile.*

      - name: Log Changed Files
        run: |
          echo "Changed files: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}"
          echo "Any changes: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed }}"

  lint:
    name: Lint Code
    needs: status-check
    if: ${{ needs.status-check.outputs.has_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.19.1
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          run_install: false

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run Linting
        run: pnpm lint-staged

  test:
    name: Test Code
    needs: status-check
    if: ${{ needs.status-check.outputs.has_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        package: [core, cli, server, mcp, rag, memory, schema-compat, auth, clients, combined-stores, deployer, docs-mcp, evals, tool-builder]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.19.1
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          run_install: false

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run Tests
        run: pnpm test:${{ matrix.package }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          RAPID_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RAPID_API_KEY }}

  build:
    name: Build Packages
    needs: status-check
    if: ${{ needs.status-check.outputs.has_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.19.1
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          run_install: false

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build All Packages
        run: pnpm build

  typecheck:
    name: Type Check
    needs: status-check
    if: ${{ needs.status-check.outputs.has_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.19.1
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          run_install: false

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run Type Checking
        run: pnpm typecheck

  format:
    name: Format Code
    needs: status-check
    if: ${{ needs.status-check.outputs.has_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20.19.1
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          run_install: false

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run Formatting
        run: pnpm prettier:format:check

  quality-assurance:
    name: Quality Assurance
    needs: [status-check, lint, test, build, typecheck, format]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.status-check.outputs.has_changes == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check Workflow Status
        run: |
          echo "All quality checks completed"
          echo "PR Number: ${{ needs.status-check.outputs.pr_number }}"
          echo "Is Pull Request: ${{ needs.status-check.outputs.is_pull_request }}"

  notify-slack:
    name: Notify Slack
    needs: [status-check, lint, test, build, typecheck, format, quality-assurance]
    if: ${{ always() && github.repository == 'mastra-ai/mastra' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Slack Notification
        uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          channel: '#contributor-alerts'
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
